Problem Statement:
Rajat is famous for being a lazy competitive programmer. This time his teacher has given him a different task : The teacher has given rajat an array of N integers . There are Q queries

Each query can be either of the following

1 x y z: add z to every element from x to y

2 x y : report the sum of all numbers from x to y

Rajat , being lazy did not want to solve this problem but since he wants to make his teacher happy he gave this task to you.

Solve this problem for Rajat
input_spec:
The first line N contains a single integer N : the number of integers in the array
The second line contains N integers - the contents of the array
The third line contains a single integer Q : the number of queries
The next Q lines can be either:
1 x y z or 2 x y as described in the problem statement
output_spec: For each type 2 query output the sum of the numbers in the required range
